title: Horriblely designed waste of money
text: Horriblely designed waste of money. These trays are horrible!  You have to pop out each individual ice cube to get the ice out of the trays!  You can not get all the cubes out at once.  Horrible design.  I used them twice and. am just going to throw them away because it just takes too much time to get the ice out of the trays.

product_metadata.title: Ice Cube Tray with Lid, 4 packs Ice Trays with Storage Container, 188 Cubes Easy Release Sillicone Ice Tray for Whiskey, Cocktail, Soda (Blue)
features: 🥤How to slide out easily: The bottom of the ice cube tray is made of flexible silicone material, you can push from the bottom. You take as many pieces as you need. If you need more ices, we recommend that you can place the ice trays for a while after being taken out from the fridge or let the bottom sit in water for a while, then it’s very convenient to make the ice slide out, and you can use some tools (spoon) replace your finger.

🥤Convenient to storage ice: We provide a box which is made of high transparent PET material to help you storage ice. It can prevent smell absorption and keep ice fresh and odorless. You can refill the ice trays everyday and keep some in the box at all times and add the cubes to your cocktail, whiskey, soda whenever you want. It can be used as an ice bin or a daily food storage container.

🥤Stackable & Save Space: Each ice tray and box has its own lid, easy to stuck, saving space, and the double-deck lid keeps ice fresh and sanitary by prevent absorbing freezer odors. You will get a storage container with lid and 4 ice cube trays with lid in total.

🥤Multifunctional ice trays: The Ice molds is made of BPA-free and high-quality plastic silicone which is safe for health and eco-friendly. You can use the trays to freeze baby food, smoothie cubes, lemonade, coffee, cocktail, whiskey, soda and any other juice. Also you can use the molds to make pudding and jelly. Note: If you want to make nice ice cube, we recommend don’t fill the water too full

🥤Large quantity is great for home use, parties and bars etc! Each ice tray makes 47 cubes, for a total of 188. We do value our customers and hope you will enjoy a pleasant shopping experience.
